title: Never lose work, agents in parallel, a bigger editor
summary: The biggest release so far: 15 features across data safety, parallel AI agents, editing, Git, settings, language servers and windows.

items.title: Local history
items.text: A snapshot on every save and right before a file is reloaded because another program rewrote it. File: Local history lists them, diffs against the buffer and restores one as a single undo step; deleted files stay reachable.

items.title: Hot exit and crash recovery
items.text: Quitting keeps unsaved tabs (untitled ones too) and reopens them next time without a prompt. Buffers are also backed up a few seconds after each edit, so a crash or a kill loses almost nothing.

items.title: Persistent undo
items.text: The undo tree of a file survives closing it and restarting, as long as the file was not changed elsewhere (2 MB per file, 48 MB overall).

items.title: File encodings
items.text: UTF-8 with or without BOM, UTF-16 LE/BE and Windows-1252 are detected and saved back the same way. Reopen or save with another encoding (Latin, KOI8-R, Shift_JIS, GBK, Big5...) from the bottom bar. Binary files are refused with a clear message.

items.title: Save as administrator
items.text: When a save is refused for permissions, a card offers to write the file in place through pkexec (Linux) or the macOS password prompt, keeping its owner and mode.

items.title: Reopen closed tab
items.text: Ctrl+Shift+T brings back the last 20 closed tabs with cursor, selection, scroll and split pane.

items.title: Confirm before killing a job
items.text: Closing a terminal, quitting or restarting asks first when a shell is running a command, a task is alive or an agent session is working. An idle shell closes without a question.

items.title: Several AI sessions
items.text: One tab per session in the AI panel, each with its own terminal, status and working folder. A badge sums up how many wait for you; Ctrl+Alt+A jumps to the next one.

items.title: Desktop notifications
items.text: A system notification when a session waits for you or finishes while Lumen is in the background (once per turn).

items.title: Paste into the agent
items.text: Long text goes as one bracketed paste, never cut. An image on the clipboard is left to the agent to read; files copied in a file manager paste as paths.

items.title: Git worktrees
items.text: List, create, open (here or in a new window), remove and prune worktrees, and start an agent session inside one.

items.title: Several terminals
items.text: Terminal tabs with rename and a two-pane split, each with its own shell and scrollback.

items.title: Kitty keyboard protocol
items.text: Modern TUIs (Claude Code, Codex, Neovim, Helix) now receive unambiguous Esc, Ctrl+key and modified Enter/Tab/Backspace.

items.title: Replace in project
items.text: Ctrl+Shift+H: case, whole word and regex with $1 captures, a preview of every replacement, replace one match, a file or everything after a count confirmation.

items.title: Macros
items.text: Record with Ctrl+Shift+R, replay with Ctrl+Alt+R or N times, as one undo step. Save them by name and bind them in keybindings.json.

items.title: Column selection
items.text: Shift+Alt+drag, middle-button drag or Ctrl+Shift+Alt+arrows: one cursor per line in visual columns.

items.title: Jump to character
items.text: Alt+J: type one or two characters and a label appears over each visible match (flash / easymotion style).

items.title: EditorConfig
items.text: indent, tab width, end of line, charset, trim trailing whitespace, final newline and max line length, with the usual section globs.

items.title: Whitespace tools
items.text: Render whitespace (boundary, trailing, all), trim trailing whitespace and insert a final newline on save as one undo step.

items.title: Rulers and inline diagnostics
items.text: Column rulers, and Error Lens style messages after the code (off, current line or all).

items.title: Highlights and linked editing
items.text: The symbol under the caret lights its other occurrences; renaming an HTML/JSX tag renames its pair live.

items.title: Right-to-left text
items.text: Arabic, Hebrew and Persian lines are shown in visual order with joined shaping, and caret, click and selection map back to the logical text. Markdown preview and hover cards follow.

items.title: Multiple windows
items.text: Ctrl+Shift+N, open a folder in a new window, drag a tab out of the window (unsaved text included). Starting lumen-text with no arguments reopens every window of the last run.

items.title: Stashes
items.text: Stash everything or selected files, apply, pop, drop and inspect a stash's diff from the Git panel.

items.title: Commit graph
items.text: Coloured lanes with merge and fork curves, branch/tag/HEAD labels, streamed a page at a time (smooth on 100k commits). Right click to check out, branch, tag, cherry-pick, revert or copy the hash.

items.title: Compare with any ref
items.text: Compare the tree or a file with a branch, tag, commit or typed ref (HEAD~3, main...), or two refs against each other.

items.title: Line staging
items.text: Select rows in the diff and stage, unstage or revert only those lines.

items.title: Ignore whitespace
items.text: A toggle for side-by-side diffs (git diff -w); staging still uses the real text.

items.title: 3-way merge editor
items.text: Incoming and Current panes over an editable Result, per-conflict checkboxes, a resolved counter and Mark resolved that stages the file.

items.title: Always up to date
items.text: git checkout, commit and pull typed in a terminal refresh the branch, gutter and status. On NFS, SMB, FUSE and similar file systems Lumen polls the open files instead; there is also a Refresh command and a refresh on window focus.

items.title: Whole-project Problems
items.text: The Problems panel can show every problem the servers know about, not just the open files (LSP pull diagnostics).

items.title: Formatter choice and code actions on save
items.text: Pick the formatter per language (auto, Biome, Prettier, a language server or none) and run organize imports / fix all before saving, with a timeout so a hung server never blocks a save.

items.title: Inline completions
items.text: Opt-in ghost text from any server that supports textDocument/inlineCompletion, such as GitHub Copilot with your own login. Tab accepts, Ctrl+Right takes a word, Alt+] cycles.

items.title: Spell checking
items.text: Opt-in harper-ls and typos-lsp as companion servers, with their fixes in the Ctrl+. menu.

items.title: Python virtualenvs
items.text: The project's venv is found and handed to pyright and ruff; Python: Select interpreter pins another one.

items.title: Test coverage
items.text: Covered, partial and uncovered bars in the gutter, plus per-file percentages in the explorer and status bar (Vitest, Jest, cargo llvm-cov, any lcov or Cobertura file).

items.title: Per-project settings
items.text: .lumen/config.json and a personal config.local.json override your settings, with per-language overrides and a User | Project switch in the settings window. Commands coming from a project file need a one-time trust prompt.

items.title: Mouse bindings
items.text: Side buttons, middle click and modifier + click or wheel can be bound in keybindings.json.

items.title: Zen mode
items.text: Ctrl+K Z hides every bar and centers the text; Esc Esc restores the layout exactly.

items.title: Explorer sorting
items.text: By name (numbers by value), type, date or mixed, with folders first or not.

items.title: Font features
items.text: OpenType features (zero, ss01...) and letter spacing for the code font, previewed in the font picker.

items.title: Image viewer
items.text: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and SVG open as a picture with zoom and pan; SVG has a Preview | Source switch.

items.title: GHP language support
items.text: Highlighting for .ghp templates (HTML, go: tags and Go expressions) and indentation that lines up <go:else/>, <go:endif/> and friends with their opener.

items.title: ghp-lsp
items.text: A bundled language server for .ghp files: diagnostics, completion, hover, definition, symbols, folding, formatting and quick fixes. Go expressions are forwarded to gopls.

items.title: Debugging GHP pages
items.text: F5 builds with ghp build --debug in the background and debugs with Delve, stopping in the .ghp file itself.

items.title: Debug panel
items.text: A toolbar and panel with Call Stack, Variables, Breakpoints, Watch and Debug Console, conditional breakpoints, logpoints and hover to evaluate.

enhancements: Restart to update no longer asks you to save first when hot exit is on.
Quitting or restarting also asks when an agent session, a terminal job, a task or a Build & Run process is alive.
Middle-button: a drag selects a column, and a click that does not move still pastes the primary selection (now on release).
Starting lumen-text with a folder that is not open yet opens its own window instead of being swallowed by the running one; an already-open folder is raised.
Refreshing git status uses --no-optional-locks, so it never rewrites .git/index and cannot trigger itself.
Switching projects restores the unsaved buffers of the project you switch to.
Opening or regaining focus checks changed open files, the git state and expanded folders, and refreshes only what changed.
The commit menu gained Checkout, Create branch/tag here, Revert, Copy hash and Undo last commit.
Ctrl+wheel zooms by default, and the back/forward mouse buttons navigate.
Language servers can open a document or web page (window/showDocument).
Git commit message files get their own language so the spell checkers apply.
The settings window gained Files, AI and Git rows, and a User | Project scope.
Pull requests now verify in about 3.5 minutes (was 6.7) and a release publishes in about 6.6 minutes (was 12.3).
Breakpoints follow edits in their file like bookmarks do, and a running debug session is sent the new lines.
Watch expressions with structured values expand into their fields.
The ghp build before a debug session runs in the background (Building... in the toolbar, errors in the Debug Console) instead of freezing the window.
.lumen/launch.json overrides program, args, env, cwd and adapter of the Go and GHP launches.
The ghp debug binary is app.exe on Windows and its folder ignores itself in git.
fixes: Ctrl+X with several cursors no longer cuts the character before a cursor that sits at the end of a shorter line.
Git events arriving within 400 ms of a tree refresh were dropped, which often lost the HEAD update of a checkout; they are now deferred instead.
A folder deleted and recreated could keep a stale inotify watch and stop reporting changes; the watch is replaced.
Image tabs cannot overwrite their file on save.
Hot-exit backups are kept per window, so two windows of one project do not sweep each other's unsaved buffers.
